title: Faster speech option, sturdier transcription
summary:
A new low-latency speech option leads a day of dashboard cleanup, more reliable Quest tracking, and repaired app listings.

ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 was added as `elevenflash`, an alpha text-to-speech model that uses the existing ElevenLabs voices and supports 32 languages. Speech requests now pass the selected model through to generation. OVH Whisper transcription also preserves uploaded filenames for format detection and accepts the provider’s `usage.seconds` response field.

Shared styling and controls now bring the Models, Keys, authorization, and device screens into line. Models has a pricing-units footer, while pinned news shows dates. Fewer one-off controls to keep track of.

Quest instructions now appear in the issue body. The payout workflow can find quests through GitHub’s PR-to-issue links, including sidebar links, and flags missing links for review instead of silently skipping them.

highlights.title: ElevenLabs Flash speech
highlights.text: Generate speech with `elevenflash`, an alpha ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 option supporting 32 languages and the existing ElevenLabs voices. It’s paid-only. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenflash).
